name: Show Indexing Errors
description: Show resources that failed search indexing for the current tenant and project.

parameter.name: resolve
parameter.documentation: If true, mark the indexing errors as resolved.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.documentation: The resources that failed search indexing.

part.name: version_id
part.documentation: Version id of the resource that failed to index.

part.name: resource_type
part.documentation: FHIR resource type of the resource that failed to index.

part.name: fhir_method
part.documentation: The operation (create, update or delete) that failed to index.

part.name: sequence
part.documentation: Sequence position of the resource in the indexing stream.

part.name: attempt_count
part.documentation: Number of times indexing has been attempted for this resource.

part.name: error_message
part.documentation: The error that occurred while indexing.

part.name: first_failed_at
part.documentation: When this resource first failed indexing.

part.name: last_failed_at
part.documentation: When this resource most recently failed indexing.

part.name: resolved_at
part.documentation: When this failure was marked resolved, if it has been.
